case_title: CCSF-OFC OF THE TREASURER-TAX COLLECTOR VS. MAHMOUD OSMAN

docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $2,493.00 FILED BY CCSF-OFFC OF THE TREASURER-TAX COLLECTOR AS TO DEFENDANT OSMAN, MAHMOUD ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR NOV-05-2014 AT 01:30 PM IN DEPT 506
PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF (FEE FOR SERVICE:$45.99) SERVED OCT-18-2014, SUBSTITUTE SERVICE ON NATURAL PERSON AS TO DEFENDANT OSMAN, MAHMOUD

SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF NOV-05-2014 - CONTINUED FOR PROGRESS REPORT TO FEB-05-2015 AT 3:30 PM IN DEPT. 506. IF NO APPEARANCES, CASE CONTINUED FOR 90 DAYS UNTIL DISMISSED BY PLAINTIFF. DEFENDANT SHALL PAY $25.00/MONTH UNTIL $2,588 IS PAID. MEDIATED DISPOSITION--IF PAYMENT IS MISSED, JUDGMENT SHALL ENTER FOR THE OUTSTANDING BALANCE. PLAINTIFF WAS PRESENT. DEFENDANT WAS PRESENT. PLAINTIFF WAS REPRESENTED BY K. DAVID L. DONAHUE JR.--SENIOR COLLECTIONS OFFICER. DEFENDANT WAIVES UNTIMELY SERVICE IN OPEN COURT. NO EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE: DONALD S. MITCHELL. CLERK: P. NATT. NOT REPORTED. (506)
